description:
Search protein-protein interactions with flexible filters.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table interaction — one record = one interactor pair mapped to one gene pair, aggregated over the pair's evidence in one source database.
Key: sourceDatabase, intA, intB, targetA, targetB, intABiologicalRole, intBBiologicalRole (targetB may be null).
Arguments: target_a accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error); target_b accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by scoring desc within sourceDatabase, then targetA asc, then targetB asc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.edge` counts edges; `_vbt.grains.partner` counts partners.
Rows with unknown count are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. Interactions from IntAct, Reactome, SIGNOR and STRING mapped to genes by OT 25.09; absence means no record in these sources.

schema.description: Pass at least one of: target_a, target_b.

target_a.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

target_b.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
